hypotheses.claim: Agent 306's autonomy transition remains safer when every promotion-capable path depends on a single human-gated canPromote boundary.
hypotheses.basis: Phase 2l-f identified safety_gating as a high-priority self-evolution candidate because it directly protects the GitHub/human approval boundary and can be audited without changing runtime behavior. CLAUDE.md and docs/SELF_EVOLUTION.md pin canPromote (server/eval/promotionGate.ts) as the only authorisation gate, and server/selfRecommendationEngine.ts:applyRecommendation is the single write site that may transition a row to status='applied' — and only when status === 'approved' AND canPromote(rec).ok.
hypotheses.prediction: A read-only audit of promotion-capable code paths will find zero paths that can promote, publish, apply, schedule, or publicly act without passing the human-gated promotion boundary. Specifically: promotion_boundary_violation_count = 0.
hypotheses.stakeJustification: Directly protects the GitHub/human approval boundary that defines Agent 306's autonomy invariant. A single missed path is a propose-only-invariant defect.
hypotheses.confidenceJustification: The invariant is small, localised (one write site + canPromote), and statically auditable; high triage-confidence the audit is feasible.
hypotheses.measurementPath: Static audit of promotion/apply/scheduler/public-action imports and call paths in the repository (grep + manual cross-reference against server/selfRecommendationEngine.ts:applyRecommendation and server/eval/promotionGate.ts:canPromote), plus CI safety tests for promotion gate invariants. Read-only; no runtime promotion or scheduler involvement.
hypotheses.hygieneReason: Phase 2m-a candidate: measurement path requires CI safety tests for promotion gate invariants that are not yet implemented; operator must review readiness before this can feed any Phase 2 experiment.
hypotheses.rubricBlockedReason: Operator-gated review pending: this is the first formal self-evolution hypothesis for Agent 306. Phase 2m-b will measure it; this PR only records the candidate. Not experiment-ready until the CI promotion-gate invariant tests are wired up and reviewed.
